details: Employers make social contributions at the rate of 16.5% for health insurance, on gross pay that is not capped (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 27 August 2026), not checked against the Tax Administration.

instruments.explanation: EUR 4.8 billion; the employees pay the pension contributions.

names.official: Households’ compulsory social contributions (employees, the self-employed and others)
names.native: Doprinosi za mirovinsko osiguranje

taxes.base: Gross salary (employees, EUR 4,508 million, withheld by the employer) and the income of the self-employed (EUR 347 million); the list’s subtotal of EUR 5,003 million also holds EUR 148 million that it does not itemise.

rate.headline: Set by the pension insurance laws
details: PwC states that the Croatian social security system covers pension and health and that the charges are borne by the employee and the employer; the employees’ rate is not extracted here.

instruments.explanation: The pension insurance contributions are collected from the employee.

names.official: Personal income tax and local surtax
names.native: Porez na dohodak

taxes.base: Wages, self-employment, rental and other income of residents; the progressive scale depends on the place of residence.

rate.headline: Two progressive rates chosen by each local unit between 15% and 33%
details: Progressive rates depend on the place of residence: each local self-government unit chooses two progressive rates between a lowest possible 15% and a highest possible 33%, within bounds that depend on its size; other income is taxed at flat rates (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 27 August 2026), not checked against the Tax Administration.

instruments.explanation: EUR 3.4 billion, 45% of the taxes and contributions in this folio. Eurostat’s accounts book all of the personal income tax under local government: the local units set the rates and the proceeds are shared between them, the counties and the State through the fiscal equalisation system.

rate.headline: Set by the Real Estate Transfer Tax Act
